record.one_liner: Telegram messaging platform with an HTTP Bot API for building bots, plus MTProto user API and Telegram Login.
record.auth_notes: Bot API uses a bot token from @BotFather as part of the request URL. Telegram Login (bots/telegram-login) is an OIDC/OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE, client credentials from BotFather. MTProto user logins use api_id/api_hash from my.telegram.org (not graded as a separate method here). critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: A bot token is obtained by messaging @BotFather and issuing /newbot; no paid plan or approval step. critic: access confirmed self_serve_free (bot tokens free; only optional paid broadcast above 30 msg/s costs Stars).
record.api_notes: Official HTTP Bot API with many methods. Also an MTProto API for user and bot logins.
record.blocker_notes: Bot tokens are free and self-serve. critic: re-searched for an official MCP, only community servers (chigwell, sparfenyuk, dryeab etc.) and third-party hosted ones; Telegram publishes none. MTProto userbot automation carries ban risk.
